title: BADF-WP-G02-001: Build Gate 02 — Requirements Decomposition and RTM
problem:
## Objective
Implement Gate 02 as the canonical BADF requirements-decomposition capability: approved PRD intent → capability/epic/requirement/NFR/acceptance/test/evidence traceability → G02 review eligibility.

## Canonical chain

`PRD objective → capability → epic → requirement/NFR → acceptance criterion → test obligation → evidence requirement`

## Scope
- canonical `badf-requirements` skill
- first-class Requirements Traceability Matrix (RTM) contract
- versioned upstream PRD-baseline reference interface (without depending on unmerged G01 implementation)
- capability, epic, functional requirement, NFR, acceptance criterion, test obligation and evidence-requirement identities
- security-sensitive requirement provenance from threat/compliance sources
- deterministic bidirectional traceability and completeness validation
- ambiguity/unresolved-decision handling
- Definition of Ready evidence for G02 review
- templates, schema, acceptance/refusal tests, routing and skill-registry integration

## External methodology inputs
- GitHub Spec Kit: specify / clarify / checklist / analyze sequencing
- softaworks requirements-clarity: functional scope, user interaction, technical constraints, business value, acceptance and ambiguity lenses
- wshobson security-requirement-extraction: threat/compliance → specific, traceable, testable security requirements

These are methodology references only. BADF owns the canonical RTM schema, evidence contract, validator and authority boundary.

## Non-goals
- no story generator that bypasses RTM traceability
- no G03–G14 implementation
- no architecture or implementation planning
- no vendored external executable
- no direct writes to `main`
- no authority to emit `G02 PASS`, `DESIGN_READY`, or open the next stage

## Acceptance target
Malformed, orphaned, cyclic, placeholder-bearing, untestable or incompletely traced requirements fail closed. A structurally and semantically complete RTM may become `ELIGIBLE_FOR_G02_REVIEW`, but independent product/gate authority remains required.

## Target delivery disposition
`IMPLEMENTED → VALIDATED → SHADOWED` for the skill capability; Gate G02 authority remains separate.
note: Issue #46 authorizes the G02 requirements/RTM capability build. Machine delivery identity is WP-2026-0028. The skill may establish review eligibility but may not approve Gate G02.
